Compliment Generator

Brighten someone's day — generate a genuine compliment from 80+ built-in lines across 5 categories, and copy it to share.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a category (or Surprise me).

Yes — pick a category or get a mix of everything.

Yes — one tap copies the compliment to your clipboard.

Yes — fully mobile friendly.
